title: Slate
description: Hypothesis slate written by Causatrix (pipeline step 6): the top-K root-cause candidates from gated rank fusion of the active rankers, plus a fused score for every service in the universe U. Read by Relentra and Causentra (03 §8).

k.description: Configured slate size K (slate.k, default 5); recorded even when U has fewer than K services (07 §3.8).

rankers_active.description: Names of the rankers that voted, sorted; rankers that abstained are absent. Ranker names are free strings because rankers are plugins (contract_changes B). Empty when no ranker voted.

candidates.description: Top-K candidates sorted by rank; length <= k (writer check). rank values are 1..n and unique (writer check). May be empty when no ranker voted.

all_scores.description: Every service in the universe U with its fused score, sorted by fused_score (rounded to 9 decimals) desc, then service A-Z. Gives Causentra the base score S0 for proposed candidates outside the top-K and bench the full ranking.

SlateFusion.title: SlateFusion
SlateFusion.description: Fusion rule and its parameters. method rrf is the default; combsum_minmax and borda are ablations (07 §9).

k.description: RRF constant (rrf.k, default 60); null for fusion methods without one.

weights.description: Fusion weight per enabled ranker (rrf.weights, a priori 1.0), keyed by ranker name.

SlateCandidate.title: SlateCandidate
SlateCandidate.description: One top-K candidate with its classification (07 §3.5-§3.6) and per-ranker votes.

rank.description: 1-based position in the slate; unique within candidates.

component.description: Component of the candidate's top internal (else external) anomaly atom; null if equal to service or absent.

ranker_ranks.description: Competition rank per enabled ranker, keyed by ranker name; null if that ranker abstained.

ranker_scores.description: Raw score per enabled ranker, keyed by ranker name; null if that ranker abstained.

SlateScore.title: SlateScore
SlateScore.description: Fused score of one service in U.
